audit_items.proof_trace: The implementation correctly maintains proposers for current+next epoch. After epoch processing at epoch N→N+1, lookahead contains proposers for epochs [N+1, N+2]. The consumer code (validators.go:312-318) correctly indexes into the lookahead array based on whether the query is for the current epoch (first half) or next epoch (second half), satisfying the post-condition that proposers for MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1 epochs are available.
